svg.title: noah@rouen — desktop
svg.desc: A macOS-style desktop for Noah (NoahSmo): an about-me window (French developer in Rouen, Next.js and Python AI at Wesur, native macOS apps in Swift, makes games), a terminal installing clawdio and HiddenBar with Homebrew, a notification with the latest GitHub push, and a pixel-art Rouen skyline at dusk.

g.text: After hours: native macOS apps in Swift —
things that live in your notch & menu bar.
Last login: Lun. 12 oct. on ttys001
Claude Code quota, right in your notch
